elaine_cs: FYI - BlueMarsh just returned the vendor risk form and flagged a request for an up-to-date dataflow snapshot + list of non-prod access holders. Can we pull together a short checklist?

tyler_cust: thanks, copying the form here -> https://files.example.com/blue-marsh/vendor-form.pdf they specifically circled: 'data flow diagram, pseudonymization controls, non-prod data access, retention for embeddings'

maria_security: @elaine_cs @sam_onboard ok. For pseudonymization we can point to our PII redaction in the ingest pipeline and the embeddings retention policy. I'll need the exact env names for non-prod access.

sam_onboard: I can run a quick account audit. Which environments should I include? staging, qa, sandbox, and demo?

elaine_cs: include staging, qa, and sandbox. Exclude demo unless they specifically ask. Also they asked for SOC2 evidence mapping for the same flows — likely we should map each flow to control evidence (logs, access reviews, encryption).

maria_security: Agreed. Quick checklist suggestion: 1) Dataflow diagram PDF (annotated) 2) List of non-prod users + last access 3) Pseudonymization description + code refs 4) Embeddings retention policy (TTL + deletion pipeline) 5) SOC2 control mapping table + sample evidence links

elaine_cs: Perfect. @audit-bot can you open a tracker ticket and assign to sam and me? Mark priority = high (renewal due in 2 weeks).

audit-bot: Created ticket RWD-7842: "BlueMarsh - dataflow snapshot & evidence". Assigned @sam_onboard, @elaine_cs. Due 2024-06-04.

sam_onboard: I'll start the non-prod access export now and paste the CSV here when ready. ETA 90m.

tyler_cust: thanks all — BlueMarsh PM said quick turnaround would help renewals. I'll ping them with expected delivery window after you paste the CSV. :thumbsup:
